followup_explanation: I routed to Dunlin-235B because this is a math problem requiring careful, accurate reasoning, and Dunlin has clearly stronger capability scores across the board — MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 74.8), GPQA Diamond (64.1 vs 54.3), and especially the quantitative-reasoning-adjacent benchmarks. The query is a benign math problem with no harm-adjacent content, so the models' differing aversion profiles (the main thing distinguishing them) are irrelevant here. With safety/content considerations not in play, the decision comes down purely to raw capability, and Dunlin is the stronger model.
